presets.name: Modular quad 5 in, 250 mm, bolted arms, 30.5 stack
presets.description: Four separate arms on 2 M3 screws each with nuts under the plate, 25 mm M3 standoffs, 30.5 x 30.5 stack, cable grooves, SMA tab. Motor pattern 16 x 19 fits most 22xx-23xx motors: check yours.

presets.name: Modular quad 5 in, dovetail quick-swap arms
presets.description: Arms drop into dovetail sockets and are held by one M3 screw each: swap a broken arm in a minute. Print one socket and arm first to check the 0.2 mm clearance.

presets.name: Modular quad 5 in, heat-set inserts, printed standoffs
presets.description: Arms carry M3 heat-set inserts, screws from under the plate; standoffs printed too. The insert hole depends on your inserts: print the fit-test coupon and type the hole size.

presets.name: Modular quad 3 in, 150 mm, M2, 20 x 20 stack
presets.description: Small frame: M2 arm screws into heat-set inserts, M2 standoffs 20 mm, 20 x 20 stack. Motor pattern 12 x 12 M2 is common for 13xx-14xx motors: check yours. Type your M2 insert hole size.

presets.name: Modular quad 7 in, 320 mm, M4 bolted arms
presets.description: Long-range size: wider, thicker arms on M4 screws and nuts, 30 mm gap for the stack and receiver. Check the motor pattern against your 28xx motor.

presets.name: Modular quad 5 in, stretch X (arms 38 deg from the nose)
presets.description: Arms closer to the nose line: longer than wide, less prop wash in the camera view. Bolted arms, 30.5 stack.

presets.name: Receiver antennas, V pair on a round standoff
presets.description: Two dipole antenna tubes at 45 deg each side (90 deg apart) on a clip that pushes onto a frame standoff. Measure the tube and the standoff.

presets.name: Receiver antennas, V pair on a hex standoff
presets.description: Same V pair for hex standoffs (aluminium or nylon). Measure across the flats.

presets.name: Single antenna tube on an arm, zip tie
presets.description: One antenna tube tilted 30 deg back, tied to an arm or boom with a zip tie. Measure the tube.

presets.name: Receiver antennas, V pair, screw mount
presets.description: V pair on a flat foot with one M3 screw: for a plate, a fuselage floor or a robot deck.
